limitations: Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.
recommended_follow_up: Request the home's DSS cost report schedules for related-party transactions and management agreements for the same years.
Compare CMS All Owners with the DPH license file and Secretary of the State business records for the legal entity and each organization listed.
For any vendor named in complaints but not in these datasets, ask DSS whether it appears on the home's related-party schedule.
